Guex is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One. He is usually on the training grounds, where he is practising his combat skills.
“
Step, parry, strike - damn it! It's just not landing.
„
— Guex practicing his swordplay

Involvement

Act One

Guex is in the training area of The Hollow within the Emerald Grove. If the player character interacts with him, he reveals his frustration with not being able to properly hit a dummy.

The player character can offer him ineffectual advice or train him by passing any of the following skill checks:

[1]
  • [ATHLETICS] Demonstrate a swing - show him the fluidity of movement he lacks. (DC 12)
  • [INSIGHT] No wonder you're struggling - you've no balance. Space your feet farther apart. (DC 10)
  • [HALF-ORC] [PERFORMANCE] Show him how to coil his shoulder muscles into a more intimidating stance before striking. (DC 7)
  • [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM] Read his thoughts.
    • Clear your mind. Past mistakes don't matter. Focus on the present, the target.

The following options automatically succeed the check and improve his training:

[1]
  • [WYLL] Try this swing. A little number I call 'The Legend's Strike'.
  • [GITHYANKI] Inspire fear with a war cry - loosen bowels before you spill them - hrath ajak!
  • [GITHYANKI] Try confusing your foe, like when you first saw me. Shout a question at them.
  • [BARBARIAN] Don't waste good anger on your thoughts - use it on that target!
  • [MONK] You need discipline, focus. Fix your gaze to a point, then guide your strikes to it.
  • [FIGHTER] Put one foot in front of the other. Let momentum aid your strikes.
  • [ROGUE] This isn't a joust. Feint with your sword, then kick between the 'legs' instead.

The following options automatically frustrate him and fail to improve his training:

  • Try hitting the target.

If the  Detect Thoughts roll fails, Guex and everyone nearby become hostile and initiate combat with the party.

If the Athletics or Insight rolls fail, Guex grows angry with the player character and can then be observed and heard to be more frustrated and worse at hitting the dummy.

If successful, the player character is rewarded with a  Battleaxe and 10 Experience. Guex can also be observed and heard to be much happier and effective at hitting the dummy. Successfully helping him train earns the ⁠To Arms! inspiration for party members with the  Soldier background.

If the party travels to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving  Kagha's ritual the Rite of Thorns, then the tieflings are expelled from the Emerald Grove and Guex's corpse is among the pile of refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village.

In the event that  Minthara and her raiding party are primed to assault the Emerald Grove, Guex moves to the grove's ramparts alongside  Pandirna, busy filling up empty barrels with oil. If the raid is stopped or if the goblins' leaders are defeated, Guex takes part in the festivities at the party's Camp, occasionally chatting with  Ikaron in an attempt to get him to drink and lighten up.

Idle banter

Before the assault on the Emerald Grove, Guex will be rallied by  Asharak:

  • Asharak
    Looking well, folks - keep it up.
  • Guex
    Yes sir!
  • Asharak
    I'm not 'sir'. I was a doorjack in Elturel.
  • Pandirna
    'Yes sir'.
  • Guex
    Shut it, you - and help me with these barrels.
  • Asharak
    Remember - get down to the cave as soon as you hear the horn.
  • Guex
    What happens if they attack before we get the signal?
  • Asharak
    I reckon you'll hear something.
  • Asharak
    Almost done?
  • Pandirna
    Nearly. We've ransacked the packs for anything that'll burn.
  • Asharak
    Good. Reckon we can brave a few nights without lamp-light if it means burning these buggers.

He can also be seen filling barrels and talking with  Pandirna:

  • Pandirna
    Gods, this oil bloody stinks.
  • Guex
    Not so bad as burning goblin will, I'd wager.
  • Pandirna
    It seems... cruel, when you say it like that.
  • Guex
    Cruel? Imagine what they'd do to us, given half the chance.
  • Pandirna
    Can we just get this done, please? I want to get below before -
  • Guex
    Before what? Afraid you might actually have to fight?
  • Pandirna
    Look. Asharak already picked who he wanted on the walls, right? And it wasn't us.
  • Guex
    You might be afraid of your own shadow, but some of us -
  • Pandirna
    Puff out your chest all you like - I'm going where it's safe.
  • Guex
    Would you be careful? We're going to spill if you don't stop shaking.
  • Pandirna
    I'm not shaking.
  • Guex
    Please, you're trembling like -
  • Pandirna
    I'm not. Shaking.
  • Guex
    All right...

Guex occasionally chats with  Kivak during the camp celebration if he survives the assault on the Emerald Grove:

  • Guex
    We're alive, Kivak. Alive!
  • Kivak
    But the others...
  • Guex
    Tonight we drink to them!
  • Kivak
    I can't lie - I'm going to miss this place a bit.
  • Guex
    One sight of the city, and you'll forget all about it.
  • Kivak
    I thought you'd never been.
  • Guex
    Ah, but I know.
  • Kivak
    I feel like I can breathe for the first time in months.
  • Guex
    Less air, more ale!

Guex will also talk to Ikaron during the same event:

  • Guex
    Grab a drink!
  • Ikaron
    I'm fine.
  • Guex
    Ah, loosen up, Ikaron!
  • Guex
    Your mug's as sour as this ale. We're supposed to be celebratin'!
  • Ikaron
    Well go bother someone else then.
  • Guex
    Agh! Spilled my pint.
  • Ikaron
    Not like you needed it.

If a party member talks to Ikaron and convinces him to drink, their banter will change:

  • Guex
    You'll have a drink, but not with me? Betrayal.
  • Ikaron
    It's not like that.
  • Guex
    You're looking flushed!
  • Ikaron
    I am a bit light-headed.
  • Guex
    Bah! Nothing another ale won't fix!
  • Guex
    Are you weaving, or is it me?
  • Ikaron
    Maybe you should drink some water.
  • Guex
    I'm fine. One more, that's all.
  • Ikaron
    I - all right.
  • Guex
    There's an animal hiding in that shell, I bet.
  • Ikaron
    I don't know what that means.
  • Guex
    Have another drink and you'll know exactly what I mean.

Notes and references

  • Guex' fate in the event that the tiefling refugees leave for Baldur's Gate is uncertain as his body never appears in the Shadow-Cursed Lands.
